name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: sudo rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list; sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y default-jre graphviz; [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; [ -f requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt; pip3 install --user streamlit; echo '✅ Packages installed and Requirements met'
